summary: Archer Aviation filed an 8-K (Items 3.02/8.01) disclosing issuance of 8,261,273 shares of Class A common stock to vendors in exchange for services/goods, with a prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b) on Form S-3 (No. 333-284812). Shares were issued pursuant to stock purchase agreements on August 17, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2), with no cash proceeds. Fenwick West LLP provided the legal opinion. This is a routine vendor-share issuance and resale registration, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event; it is an ordinary unregistered equity issuance for vendor compensation.
